canonical_project: Douxun Cloud Computing / Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Provincial government reported the RMB 3 billion Douxun cloud-computing data-center project as a major Putian project with 5,000 cabinets and 100,000 servers planned. CCTV/local coverage in 2024 placed the project in Licheng District, said construction began in November 2022, and described phase 1 as about 95,000 sq m with nearly 6,000 standard racks and about 20,000P compute.
